मुर् {c6c} P. (मुरति) To encircle,
surround, encompass, entwine.

मुरः N. of a demon slain by
[]
Kṛṣṇa; पार्थेनाथ द्विषन्मुरं Śi. 2. 1.
--रा N. of a fragrant plant.
--रं
Encompassing, surrounding.
--Comp.
--अरिः {1} an epithet of Kṛṣṇa;
मुरारिमारादुपदर्शयंत्यसौ

. {2} N. of
the author of Anargharāghava.
--जित्, --द्विष्, --भिद्, --मर्दन, --रिपु,
--वैरिन्, --हन् m. epithets of Kṛṣṇa or
Viṣṇu; प्रकीणार्सृग्बिंदुर्जयति भुजदंडो
मुरजितः

; मुरवैरिणो राधिकानधि
वचनजातं 10.
--दः the discus of
Viṣṇu.

मुरगंडः An eruption on the
face.

मुरजः [मुरात् वेष्टनात् जायते जण्-ड
Tv.]
1 A kind of drum or tabor;
सानंदं नंदिहस्ताहतमुरजरव &c.

.
--2 A stanza
artificially arranged in the form of
a drum; also called मुरजबंध, see
K.

1 A large drum.
--2 N. of
Kubera's wife.

मुरंडाः m. pl. A country to the
north-west of India.

मुरंदला N. of a river
(supposed to be the same as Narmadā).

1 A kind of fresh-water
fish.
--2 A king of the Muralas.
--लाः pl. N. of a country.

मुरली A flute, pipe.
--Comp.
--धरः an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.

मुर्छ् {c1c} P. (मूर्छति, मूर्छित or मूर्तं;
the word is written as मूर्छ् or मूर्च्छ्)
1 To settle into a solid form,
coagulate, congeal.
--2 To faint, swoon,
faint away; lose consciousness,
become senseless; पतत्युद्याति
मूर्च्छत्यपि

.
--3 To grow, increase, become strong
or powerful; मुमूर्च्छ सहजं तेजो
हविषेव हविर्भुजः

.
--4 To gather strength, thicken,
become dense, prevail; तमसां निशि मूर्च्छतां

.
--5 To take effect on; छाया
[]
न मूर्च्छति मलोपहतप्रसादे शुदे तु दर्पणतले
सुलभावकाशा Ś. 7. 32; हर्म्येषु मूर्छंति न
चंद्रपादाः

‘are not
reflected’ &c. (b) To prevail against,
have power against; न
पादपोन्मूलनशक्ति रंहः शिलोच्चये मूर्छति मारुतस्य

.
--7 To be a match for.
--8 To be
frequent.
--9 To cause to sound
loudly. --Caus. (मूर्छयति-ते)
1 To
stupefy, cause to faint;
म्लेच्छान्मूर्छयते

.
--2 To strengthen,
increase.
--3 To excite, stir up.
--4
To cause to sound loudly, play on
(as a musical instrument).

मुर्मुरः [मुर् क पृषो˚द्वित्वं Tv.]
1 A fire
made of chaff, chaff-fire;
स्मरहुताशनमुर्मुचूर्णतां दधुरिवाम्रवणस्य रजःकणाः
Śi. 6. 6.
--2 The god of love.
--3
N. of one of the horses of the sun.

Stupefied,
bewildered.
--2 Foolish, silly stupid.
--3
Destroying, killing.

मूर्ख a. Stupid, dull-headed,
foolish, silly.
--र्खः
1 A fool,
blockhead; न तु
प्रातनिविष्टमूर्खजनचित्तमाराधयत्

.
--2 A kind of bean.
--Comp.
--पंडितः a learned fool;

.
--भूयं folly, stupidity, ignorance.
--भ्रातृक a. one who has a foolish
brother.
--मंडलं an assembly of
fools.

मूर्खता --त्वं, मूर्खिमन् m. Stupidity,
folly, silliness.

मूर्खता --त्वं, मूर्खिमन् m. Stupidity,
folly, silliness.

मूर्खता --त्वं, मूर्खिमन् m. Stupidity,
folly, silliness.

मूर्च्छन a. (नी f.)
1
Stupefying, producing insensibility or
stupor (an epithet applied to
one of the five arrows of Cupid).
[]
--2 Increasing, augmenting,
strengthening.
--नं, --ना [मुर्च्छ् युच्]
1
Fainting, swooning.
--2 Prevalence,
growth, increase (usually n. in this
sense).
--3 A process in metallic
preparation, calcining quicksilver
with sulphur; cf. मूर्च्छा (3) also.
--4 (In music) The rising of sounds,
an intonation, a duly
regulated rise and fall of sounds
conducting the air and the harmony
through the keys in a pleasing
manner, changing the key or
passing from the key to another;
modulation, melody;
स्फुटीभवद्ग्रामविशेषमूर्च्छनां Śi. 1. 10; भूयो भूयः
स्वयमपि कृतां मूर्च्छनां विस्मरंती

; (a मूर्च्छ or
मूर्च्छना is thus defined:
--क्रमात्स्वराणां
सप्तानामारोहश्चावरोहणम । सा मूर्च्छेत्युच्यते
ग्रामस्था एताः सप्त सप्त च ॥ see Malli. on
Śi. 1. 10 for further information).

.
--2
Spiritual ignorance or delusion.
--3 A
process in calcining metals; मूर्च्छां गतो
मृतो वा निदर्शनं पारदोऽत्र रसः

.
--4 The rising of sounds &c.; see
मूर्च्छन (4) above.
--5 Growth,
increase
--Comp. आक्षेपः (in Rhet.)
expressing strong dissent by a swoon.
--पगीत a. unconscious, fainted away.

मूर्च्छाल a. Fainted, in sensible,
senseless.

मूर्च्छित p. p. [मूर्च्छा जाता अस्य तार˚
इतच्, मुर्छ् क्त वा]
1 Fainted, swooning,
insensible.
--2 Foolish, stupid, silly.
--3 Increased, augmented.
--4 Made
violent, intensified.
--5 Perplexed,
bewildered.
--6 Filled.
--7 Calcined.
--8 Rising upwards, lofty.
--तं A
kind of song or air.

मूर्त a. [मुर्च्छ्-क्त]
1 Fainted,
insensible.
--2 Stupid, foolish.
--3
Embodied, incarnate; मूर्तो
विघ्नस्तपस इव नो भिन्न मारंगयूथः Ś. 1. 33;
प्रसाद इव मूर्तस्ते स्पर्शः स्नेहार्द्रशतिलः

.
--4 Material,
corporeal.
--5 Solid, hard.
--6 Real.
--7
Thickened, coagulated (Ved.).

1 Embodiment, materiality.
--2 (In phil.) Having a finite or
fixed measure or motion;
परिच्छिन्नपरिमाणवत्त्वं क्रियावत्त्वं वा मूर्तत्वम्.

मूर्तिः f. [मुर्च्छ्-क्तिन्]
1 Anything
which has definite shape and limits,
material element, matter,
substance.
--2 A form, visible shape,
body, figure;

.
--4 An image, idol, a statue.
--5
Beauty.
--6 Solidity, hardness.
--Comp.
--धर, --संचर a. embodied, incarnate;
धर्मो बा मूर्तिसंचरः

.
--पः a worshipper of an image,
one who is in charge of an idol.

.
--3 The highest or most
prominent part, top, summit, peak,
head; अतिष्ठन्मनुजेंद्राणां मूर्ध्नि
देवपतिर्यथा Mb. ‘stood at the head of all
kings’ &c.; भूम्यां पर्वतमूर्धनि;
Ś. 5. 7;

.
--4 (Hence) A leader,
head, chief, foremost, prominent.
--5
Front, van, forepart; स किल
संयुगमूर्ध्नि सहायतां मघवतः प्रतिपद्य महारथः

.
--6 (In geom.) The base.
--Comp.
--अंतः the crown of the
head.
--अभिषिक्त a. f. consecrated,
crowned, inaugurated;

मूर्धाभिषिक्तमुदाहरणम्.
--(क्तः) {1} a
consecrated king. {2} a man of the
Kṣatriya caste. {3} a minister. {4} =
मूर्धावसिक्त (1) q. v.
--अभिषेकः
censecration, inauguration.
--अवसिक्तः {1} N.
of a particular mixed tribe sprung
from a Brāhmaṇa father and
Kṣatriya mother. {2} a consecrated king.
--कर्णी, --कर्परी f. an umbrella.
--जः
{1} the hair (of the head); पर्याकुला
मूर्धजाः Ś. 1. 30; विललाप
विकीर्णमूर्धजा

‘she tore her hair for
grief’. {2} the mane.
--ज्योतिस् n.
[]
see ब्रह्मरंध्र or मुद्रामार्ग.
--पिंडः a lump
upon the head (of an elephant in
rut).
--पुष्पः the Śirīṣa tree.
--रसः
the scum of boiled rice.
--वेष्टनं a
turban, diadem.

मूर्धन्य a. [मूर्ध्नि भवः यत्]
1 Being
in or on the head.
--2 Cerebral or
lingual, a term applied to the letters
ऋ, ॠ, ट्, ठ्, ड्, ढ्, ण्, र्, and ष्; ऋटुरषाणां
मूर्धा.
--3 Chief, pre-eminent, most
excellent.

मूर्वा --र्वी, मूर्विका A kind of
creeper (from the fibres of which
bow-strings and the girdle of Kṣatriyas
are made).

मूर्वा --र्वी, मूर्विका A kind of
creeper (from the fibres of which
bow-strings and the girdle of Kṣatriyas
are made).

मूर्वा --र्वी, मूर्विका A kind of
creeper (from the fibres of which
bow-strings and the girdle of Kṣatriyas
are made).

मुरारि Author of the Anargha-rāghava mentioned by
the poet Ratnākara (who flourished in the 9th
century) in Haravijaya 38. 67. He must, therefore
be placed before the 9th century.
